hero.title: Stop losing money to detention. Stop trusting bad brokers.
hero.subtitle: VettGuard runs detention claims and broker vetting on autopilot. One click, every load board. You approve — Claude does the rest.

extension.title: Lives inside DAT, Truckstop, 123Loadboard
extension.body: Vet a broker, file a detention claim, generate a rate-con response — without leaving the load board you already use.

detention.title: Detention recovery on autopilot
detention.body: Motive and Samsara ELD data proves dwell time. Claude drafts the claim packet. You click send. We take 18% only when you get paid.

vetting.title: Continuous broker monitoring
vetting.body: FMCSA authority, bond, complaint history, payment patterns — re-scored monthly. Watchlist alerts the moment a broker turns risky.

security.title: Bank-grade security
security.body: End-to-end encryption, row-level tenant isolation, full audit log. Your carrier data never leaks.

pricing.title: Honest pricing
pricing.subtitle: Pay for the outcome. Cancel anytime.

vetting.name: Broker Vetting
vetting.description: Unlimited broker checks + continuous monitoring + watchlist alerts.

detention.name: Detention Recovery
detention.description: We only get paid when we recover detention for you. No subscription, no setup fee.

eld.a: Motive and Samsara at launch — together about 70% of US carriers. Geotab, Verizon Connect, KeepTruckin Lite, and others on the roadmap.

loadboards.q: Which load boards does the Chrome extension cover?
loadboards.a: DAT, Truckstop, and 123Loadboard at launch. We are adding Sylectus, Direct Freight, RXO, Uber Freight, and others every month.

fees.q: How do you collect the 18% detention fee?
fees.a: When the broker pays you, we send a single Stripe invoice for 18% of the recovered amount. You pay only after you get paid.
